title: Agree the first mapping milestone: stationary simulated scan export and reload
summary: James approved M1: reuse the approximate Mid-360 model in a fixed sensor-only floor/wall scene, export one scan and sensor pose, reopen independently, and compare geometry. The existing smoke check prints a report; the missing export/reload is the bounded implementation. Scope approval does not accept a capability or resume research. Fixture details, noise settings, thresholds and assignment remain open.
